failure_catalogue.name: Stale base under strict checks
failure_catalogue.rule: Refresh main immediately before merge; stale green checks are insufficient.

failure_catalogue.name: Superseded PR still counted as concurrent intent
failure_catalogue.rule: Close/supersede predecessor before replacement when practical or provide a real IntegrationReceipt.

failure_catalogue.name: Missing AgentWorkIntent
failure_catalogue.rule: Create complete intent at draft PR creation.

failure_catalogue.name: Changed path missing from intent
failure_catalogue.rule: Derive target paths from the final diff and keep intent current.

failure_catalogue.name: Missing IntegrationReceipt
failure_catalogue.rule: Compare overlapping semantics and record composition evidence/tests before claiming compatibility.

failure_catalogue.name: Concurrent edits caused merge conflicts
failure_catalogue.rule: Use early draft intents, narrow branches, and fresh integration branches for genuine collisions.

failure_catalogue.name: Protected/non-fast-forward branch update
failure_catalogue.rule: No force push; use forward commits or fresh replacement branches.

failure_catalogue.name: Malformed JSON discovered late
failure_catalogue.rule: Parse changed structured files before PR and still run reference closure.

failure_catalogue.name: Runtime/generated reference looked like missing file
failure_catalogue.rule: Register generated/runtime references with their producer; never create fake placeholders.

failure_catalogue.name: Stale config-surface fingerprint
failure_catalogue.rule: Recompute fingerprints and consumers/tests in the same work package.

failure_catalogue.name: Tests hardcoded old model/family assumptions
failure_catalogue.rule: Search for stale assumptions and assert invariants rather than obsolete exact values unless exactness is required.

failure_catalogue.name: Premature duplicate aggregate failures
failure_catalogue.rule: Incomplete mandatory set is UNKNOWN/DEFERRED; final PASS/FAIL only after all required lanes settle.

failure_catalogue.name: Classic commit-status endpoint incomplete for Actions
failure_catalogue.rule: Use workflow/PR check evidence and ruleset contexts.

failure_catalogue.name: Code-search lag after merge
failure_catalogue.rule: Use direct exact-ref fetch for proof; search is discovery.

failure_catalogue.name: Auto-merge assumption
failure_catalogue.rule: Do not attempt auto-merge without fresh setting evidence.

failure_catalogue.name: AAP floor mismatch
failure_catalogue.rule: Derive assurance tier/modules from the material change; never lower them to make CI green.

failure_catalogue.name: Human admission / trusted-base mismatch
failure_catalogue.rule: Never fabricate or broaden human approval; bind it to exact governed scope.

failure_catalogue.name: Blind workflow retry
failure_catalogue.rule: Inspect typed failure first; retry only after state/input change or proven transient failure.

failure_catalogue.name: Bad merge discovered after admission
failure_catalogue.rule: Never rewrite main; recover via typed revert-or-forward-fix PR from current main and revalidate dependents.

github_field_notes.extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes: GitHub ruleset field concerning unattributed Copilot-created PRs; with required approving review count 0 it does not currently add a functional approval requirement.

loading_order: live default-branch head and applicable GitHub rulesets
the process file named by PROCESS_CURRENT.json
CHATGPT_WORKSTREAM_POLICY.json for parallel ChatGPT Git work
canonical/source manifests and applicable domain policies/modules

bad_merge.forward_fix_preferred_when: revert would remove valid intervening dependent work or worsen state
required_path: freeze dependent merge-train entries by dependency invalidation
create recovery branch from current main
choose revert commit or forward-fix with explicit rationale
open recovery PR with AgentWorkIntent and preflight receipt
run ordinary required checks and applicable Garden process/ActionGate/human gates
bad_merge.revert_preferred_when: bounded reversal is safer and preserves exact provenance

request_efficiency: no repeated same-hash reads by default
reuse verified head/ruleset/process/context hashes until invalidated
after 429 stop optional calls and resume from checkpoint
exact-ref fetch is proof; search is discovery

entry_conditions: required checks green for current composition
workstream not stale abandoned superseded or closed
